capabilities: Lock protected files, folders, or the entire vault behind a password prompt
Set and verify the password from the settings toggle
Auto-lock after a configurable number of idle minutes
Add up to 6 additional protected paths
disambiguation: Not an encryption tool; it only pops a password prompt and never encrypts or modifies note contents.
extras: The README stresses the lock is prompt-only ("No encrypt, no decrypt"), so note files remain unencrypted and readable outside Obsidian. Tested on Windows and iOS with Obsidian 2023.5; manual installation instructions included alongside community-plugin install.
motivation: The author built it to prevent their girlfriend from peeking at private notes and diaries in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to stop someone with device access from opening private notes or diaries.
summary: Password-protection plugin that gates access to chosen files, folders, or the whole vault behind a password prompt without encrypting notes.
